title: barosma dioica var. linifolia
intro: Barosma dioica var. linifolia, commonly known as Wild Buchu, is a variety of the Barosma dioica plant, belonging to the Rutaceae family. It is a shrub native to South Africa, traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Wild Buchu include its ability to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Wild Buchu are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
